# Domain Model Rigor Checklist: Domínio de Despesa Recorrente

**Purpose**: Standard pre-implementation gate validating that the requirements in `spec.md` are complete, clear, consistent, and testable enough to model as a DDD Aggregate/Entity/Value Object set — before `/speckit-tasks` breaks the plan into implementation work.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are validation requirements defined for every field accepted at creation (name, category, amount, due day, start date, frequency, status, note)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the behavior fully specified for a status value supplied as explicitly empty/null at creation (falls back to Ativa, or is rejected)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what makes a start date "valid" beyond being a real calendar date (e.g., any restriction relative to today)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a maximum length or character-set constraint defined for the despesa name, beyond "not empty/not whitespace-only"? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a maximum length or format constraint defined for the optional observação field? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are volume/pagination expectations defined for retrieving the set of active despesas? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "competência do mês corrente" precise enough (e.g., always month/year-only) to unambiguously compare against a despesa's start-date competência? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the comparison "competência do mês corrente igual ou posterior à competência da data de início" explicitly stated as month/year-only, ignoring day-of-month? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "quantia em reais (BRL)" scoped clearly enough to confirm no multi-currency or currency-selection requirement exists? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the boundary behavior for a value with more than two decimal places precise about rejection vs. rounding (e.g., is 10.005 rejected or rounded)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the occurrence-generation rules (FR-011, FR-012, FR-013) mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive across every combination of status × start-date competência? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011-FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the Key Entities section's field descriptions for Despesa Recorrente/Ocorrência align with the Functional Requirements' descriptions of the same fields? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities vs §FR]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the Ocorrência status list (Pendente/Paga) in the Key Entities section consistent with FR-019, which only ever produces Pendente within this feature's scope? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, FR-019]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-001 ("100% das despesas... resultam em exatamente uma ocorrência") be objectively measured given the current requirements, or does it depend on an unstated definition of "dentro do período de vigência"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-006 ("sem perda ou alteração dos dados originalmente cadastrados") measurable, i.e., is the exact field set that must round-trip explicitly defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Is each success criterion (SC-001-SC-006) traceable to at least one functional requirement and one acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Is there a requirement/scenario covering a despesa created as Ativa whose start-date competência is exactly equal to (not before) the current competência? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK018 Is there a requirement/scenario covering retrieval of a despesa identifier that does not exist? [Gap, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK019 Is there a requirement/scenario covering an empty result when searching for active despesas? [Gap, Spec §User Story 3, Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are all short months (not only the February example) explicitly covered by the due-day adjustment requirement? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a requirement defined for a due day that falls before the despesa's own start date within the same first competência? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Is leap-year February (29 days) addressed distinctly from the general "fewer days" rule in FR-006? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the rejection behavior for an invalid category value specified precisely enough (e.g., case sensitivity, unknown value handling) to be unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption that "Ocorrência" is always an internal entity (never an independent aggregate) reconciled with the refinement document's own open question about the future monthly panel needing to list occurrences across many despesas at once? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the "no name-uniqueness restriction" assumption confirmed as an intentional permanent decision, versus merely "not addressed this phase"? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the caller's obligation to supply "competência do mês corrente" (FR-021) documented as a precondition of the creation operation, not only mentioned in the Clarifications log? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications, FR-021]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Does the spec clarify whether rejecting a non-mensal frequency must be distinguishable (e.g., by error type/message) from other validation failures, or is any rejection equally acceptable? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK028 Is FR-018 ("Pausada nunca gera novas ocorrências enquanto permanecer pausada") fully verifiable within this feature's scope, given this feature implements no status-transition capability at all? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
